title: Reckoner about (v2)
description: A left-aligned section on linen paper: a small boxed eyebrow and a long 32px statement across two thirds of the page, then three equal white cards across the full width, each with an artwork slot at the top left, a long pause, a 22px title and a few lines of grey text. The statement fades in as it scrolls into view, and the cards rise 24px and fade in one after another.
notes: the reveals are CSS scroll-driven animations (no JavaScript); browsers without them show everything in place
cards use the card colour (white) on the background colour (linen): keep the two apart in the theme
media slots are 120×120 placeholders (80×80 on phones) until filled
